newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AMALIA TO ENHANCE LIBERIAN INTERESTS.
newsitem.headline: AMALIA TO ENHANCE LIBERIAN INTERESTS.

text.p: Amalia Gold Mining and Exploration Ltd said on Friday a number of proposals were being considered which were intended to result in participation by it and Commonwealth Gold plc in its Liberian interests.

It said that on June 19, an associate company Holistic Resources had signed an agreement with the Liberian government establishing Liberia Resources Corp (Liberesco), a national public corporation holding right and title to all minerals in Liberia.
Liberesco is 60 percent held by the Liberian government and 40 percent by Holistics.
It said the election of Charles Taylor as Liberian president on July 19, together with the stability expected to flow from it, had enhanced Amalia's initiatives.
Details of the proposed restructuring, which would result in participation by Amalia in a wide range of other commodities, would be announced shortly.
Until then, shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
